name: CI/CD Pipeline - Dev Test, Approval, Prod Deploy with Rollback
description: EDA or webhook fires this workflow after CI pipeline success. AO owns the full CD pipeline: deploy and test in dev, human approval gate for prod, production deployment with smoke test, and automatic rollback to snapshot on failure. AI is used specifically to write contextual ServiceNow work notes at key events. ServiceNow updates are embedded in AAP job steps to keep the canvas lean. One Linux host on AWS runs both dev (port 8080) and prod (port 80) for demo.
